notes.quantity: Quantities are for 4 servings, in the ingredient's unit. Salt, black pepper and water are not listed.
notes.keepsDays: Approximate days in the fridge; 0 means eat the same day. Not a food-safety guarantee.
notes.frequency: Estimated home-cooking frequency: 3 = very often, 2 = often, 1 = occasionally.
notes.pantry: Pantry ingredients are not added to the shopping list automatically; the user is asked whether they have them.
notes.nutrition: nutritionPer100g is per 100 g of the edible part (ediblePortion), approximate, mostly from USDA FoodData Central (CC0) reference foods. gramsPerUnit converts other units to grams; eatenShare is the part of a line that ends up eaten (frying oil, syrup). A dish's portions (default: servings) divides its nutrition.
